# DigiCraft

> AI-generated custom digital products — planners, storybooks, guides, affirmation cards, and printable templates delivered as PDFs within 60 seconds of purchase.

DigiCraft lets you customize a digital product through a short form, pay securely, and receive a unique, AI-generated PDF instantly. Products are printable on A4 or Letter paper and saved to your dashboard for re-download.

- [Home](/): What DigiCraft is and featured product categories.
- [Browse Products](/products): All AI digital product types organized by category.
- [FAQ](/faq): How DigiCraft works, delivery, payments, and refunds.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the DigiCraft team.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
